;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|Afghanistan War]]
**A suicide bomber attack near a group of security personnel investigating illegal drugs and alcohol dealing in [[Kabul]], Afghanistan, kills at least 20, wounding another 27 policemen.  The [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|Islamic State]] claims responsibility for the attack. [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/01/04/world/asia/isis-kabul-suicide-attack.html (''The New York Times'')]  [http://time.com/5089352/kabul-afghanistan-suicide-attack-police/ (AP via ''Time'')]

;Business and economy
*[[Munich Re]] reports that the [[insurance]] industry faces record claims of [[US$]]135 billion from [[Natural disaster|natural catastrophe]]s, such as the [[2017 Mexico earthquake|Mexico earthquakes]], [[2017 South Asian floods|South Asian floods]], [[2017 California wildfires|California wildfires]] and [[2017 Atlantic hurricane season|Atlantic hurricanes]] in 2017. Overall economic losses from natural disasters are estimated at the second highest amount since 2011. [https://www.insurancejournal.com/news/national/2018/01/04/476093.htm (''Insurance Journal'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[January 2018 North American blizzard]]
**The [[Norwegian Cruise Line]]'s [[Norwegian Breakaway]] [[cruise ship]] travels through the storm, delaying its arrival in [[New York City]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/newyork/news/cruise-through-storm/ (CBS News)] [https://cruisefever.net/winter-storm-grayson-delays-cruise-ship-arrival-new-york/ (Cruisefever.net)]
**A massive winter storm hits the [[East Coast of the United States]] with up to 18 inches of snow predicted to fall between [[The Carolinas]] and [[Maine]]. So far, three people have died in [[North Carolina]] and one person has died in [[Philadelphia]], [[Pennsylvania]]. [https://www.yahoo.com/news/huge-swath-us-hit-winter-061934751.html (AP via Yahoo!)]<!-- is this relevant to today?-->
*[[2018 Kroonstad train crash]]
**A [[Shosholoza Meyl|Shosholoza]] train collides with a vehicle at a crossing near [[Kroonstad]] in the [[Free State (province)|Free State]], [[South Africa]], killing 19 and injuring at least 100 people. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-42565653 (BBC News)] [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/africa/south-africa-train-crash-latest-truck-collision-passengers-injured-hennenman-kroonstad-free-state-a8141261.html (''The Independent'')] [https://www.news24.com/SouthAfrica/News/death-toll-in-free-state-train-crash-rises-to-12-rescuers-search-for-more-bodies-20180104 (News24)]

;International relations
*[[Pakistan–United States relations]]
**The U.S. State Department suspends its security [[aid|assistance]] to [[Pakistan]]. [http://abcnews.go.com/International/us-suspends-security-assistance-pakistan-trump-tweets/story?id=52149646 (ABC News)]
*[[Iran–United States relations]]
**The [[U.S. Treasury]] sanctions five Iranian entities associated with [[Iran]]'s [[ballistic missile]] program. [https://www.politico.com/story/2018/01/04/treasury-sanctions-iranian-entities-ballistic-missile-production-324977 (''Politico'')]
*[[North Korea–South Korea relations]]
**[[North Korea]] accepts [[South Korea]]'s proposal for official talks, and will meet on January 9 to discuss North Korea's possible involvement with the [[2018 Winter Olympics]] in South Korea. These are the first high-level talks between the Koreas in more than two years. [http://edition.cnn.com/2018/01/04/asia/north-korea-south-korea-talks-intl/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-42574870 (BBC)]

;Law and crime
*[[Marijuana policy of the Donald Trump administration]]
**[[U.S. Attorney General]] [[Jeff Sessions]] rescinds three Obama-era memos that had adopted a policy of non-interference with states that have legalized recreational [[marijuana]]. [https://apnews.com/19f6bfec15a74733b40eaf0ff9162bfa (Associated Press)]
*A [[United Airlines]] flight headed from [[Chicago]] to [[Hong Kong]] makes an emergency landing in [[Anchorage, Alaska]], after a passenger allegedly became unruly. [http://www.ktuu.com/content/news/Flight-to-Hong-Kong-diverted-to-Anchorage-468105743.html (KTUU-TV)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Virginia House of Delegates election, 2017]]
**A drawing is held to resolve a [[Virginia's 94th House of Delegates district|tied election]] between [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democrat]] Shelly Simonds and [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] [[David Yancey]], with Yancey being randomly chosen as the winner. [http://abcnews.go.com/Politics/republican-wins-draw-tied-virginia-house-delegates-race/story?id=52142132 (ABC News)]
